documents.IDD-0001.spec-copy.md:
# Copy
The user requests copying a file. The application reads its content from persistent file storage, writes a destination file to persistent storage, and displays success or a human-facing failure.
documents.IDD-0002.spec-copy-options.md:
# Copy options
This document extends the same user-triggered Copy process: the user may select overwrite behavior. The application still copies the requested source and reports success or failure; this is not a second independently triggered copy workflow.
documents.IDD-0003.spec-open.md:
# Open file
The user selects Open. The application reads the selected persisted file content and displays it to the user.
documents.IDD-0004.spec-rename.md:
# Rename file
The user submits a new name for a selected persisted file. The application updates the stored name and confirms the result or reports an error to the user.
documents.IDD-0005.spec-folder.md:
# Create folder
The user requests creation of a named folder. The application persists the folder and confirms completion or reports an error.
documents.IDD-0006.spec-preferences.md:
# Display preferences
The user opens Preferences. The application reads previously saved settings from persistent storage and displays them to the user.

expectedMovements: Copy: E request / R source / W destination / X result
Open: E request / R file / X content
Rename: E request / W stored name / X result
Create folder: E request / W folder / X result
Preferences: E request / R settings / X settings
